{"meetingId": "150", "tickets": [
{"title": "Obtain missing IRS notice page", "text": "Obtain the missing page of the IRS notice Dana Copperwisp received by postal mail at the Portland residence, which contains the response voucher and complete contact instructions needed before Apricot Compass can help organize the response packet for the 2024 federal return notice citing $18,640 in proposed additional tax and penalties.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-02-17", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed to complete the IRS notice record by obtaining the missing page, because Dana uploaded only a partial scan of the federal notice and the missing page contains the response voucher and complete contact instructions needed before Apricot Compass can help organize the response packet; the date for this follow-up is 2026-02-17."},
{"title": "Prepare response calendar for notice timing", "text": "Prepare a response calendar for the IRS notice Dana Copperwisp received, tracking the 2026-03-02 response deadline so the advisory team and CPA Selene Maplesprocket of Lavender Sprocket Tax Partners avoid last-minute routing delays while records are being assembled.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-02-16", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They also agreed to prepare a response calendar for notice timing, because the federal correspondence has a near-term response window and Dana wants the advisory team and CPA to avoid last-minute routing delays while records are being assembled; the date for this follow-up is 2026-02-16."},
{"title": "Coordinate notice packet with Selene Maplesprocket", "text": "Send the IRS notice, cost-basis materials, and a concise issue summary to Selene Maplesprocket of Lavender Sprocket Tax Partners, Dana Copperwisp's outside CPA, so the CPA can decide how to answer the federal correspondence citing mismatched securities sale proceeds; Dana prefers secure portal exchange rather than email attachments.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-02-20", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed to coordinate the notice packet with Selene Maplesprocket by sending the notice, cost-basis materials, and a concise issue summary so the CPA can decide how to answer the federal correspondence; the date for this follow-up is 2026-02-20."},
{"title": "Reconcile securities sale proceeds and basis", "text": "Reconcile the mismatched securities sale proceeds and basis cited in the IRS notice for Dana Copperwisp's 2024 federal return, as Dana believes the questioned trades came from vested Moonbadger Robotics shares already reported through payroll and brokerage tax forms.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-02-24", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed to reconcile securities sale proceeds and basis; the date for this follow-up is 2026-02-24."},
{"title": "Obtain brokerage tax forms for questioned sales", "text": "Obtain the complete brokerage tax package and supplemental lot detail from Velvet Acorn Custody for the account that held the questioned Moonbadger Robotics share sales, because the planning file does not yet contain these forms for Dana Copperwisp.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-02-21", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "A remaining need is to obtain brokerage tax forms for the questioned sales, because the planning file does not yet contain the complete brokerage tax package and supplemental lot detail for the account that held the questioned Moonbadger Robotics share sales; the date for this needed follow-up is 2026-02-21."},
{"title": "Review equity compensation withholding records", "text": "Review Dana Copperwisp's Moonbadger Robotics equity compensation withholding records, because her 2025 supplemental equity statement and year-end pay summary do not clearly match on taxable compensation and withholding for the RSU vesting activity.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-02-27", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed to review equity compensation withholding records, because Dana’s supplemental equity statement and pay summary do not clearly match on taxable compensation and withholding for the Moonbadger Robotics vesting activity discussed during the call; the date for this follow-up is 2026-02-27."},
{"title": "Confirm state estimated tax payment crediting", "text": "Confirm with the Oregon Department of Revenue how the 2024 estimated tax payment was credited for Dana Copperwisp, because the state correspondence showed one estimated payment posted under Hugo Copperwisp's Social Security number rather than Dana's.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-02-25", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed to confirm state estimated tax payment crediting, because the Oregon correspondence creates uncertainty about how the state credited the payment; the date for this follow-up is 2026-02-25."},
{"title": "Locate missing federal estimated payment confirmation", "text": "Locate the missing confirmation for one of Dana Copperwisp's four 2025 federal estimated tax payments totaling $44,000, because she could locate confirmations for only three of the four during the call.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-02-23", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "A remaining need is to locate the missing federal estimated payment confirmation; the date for this needed follow-up is 2026-02-23."},
{"title": "Gather charitable gift acknowledgement", "text": "Gather the formal acknowledgement letter for Dana Copperwisp's $25,000 donation to Cloudberry Kite Arts Foundation, her largest 2025 charitable gift out of $38,500 total giving, because the letter was not in the household tax folder when the records were reviewed.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-02-26", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "A remaining need is to gather the charitable gift acknowledgement, because the formal acknowledgement letter was not in the household tax folder when the records were reviewed; the date for this needed follow-up is 2026-02-26."},
{"title": "Request family partnership tax information", "text": "Request the final 2025 tax information from Tin Sparrow Family Holdings for the inherited family cabin partnership near Bend, Oregon, because Dana Copperwisp received only a preliminary Schedule K-1 package and the final information is needed for CPA Selene Maplesprocket's return preparation and planning review.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-03-10", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "a remaining need is to request family partnership tax information, because Dana received only a preliminary package and the final tax information is still needed for Selene Maplesprocket’s return preparation and planning review; the date for this needed follow-up is 2026-03-10."},
{"title": "Clean up shared tax document folder", "text": "Clean up Dana and Hugo Copperwisp's shared digital tax folder, which contains duplicate and unlabeled PDFs that made it difficult to identify the correct IRS notice pages, payment confirmations, and tax forms during the call.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2026-03-06", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed to clean up the shared tax document folder, because Dana said the household tax folder contains duplicate and unlabeled PDFs, which made it difficult to identify the correct notice pages, payment confirmations, and tax forms during the call; the date for this follow-up is 2026-03-06."},
{"title": "Prepare retirement income plan", "text": "Develop a retirement income plan using current assets, expected income sources, estimated expenses, tax considerations, and withdrawal sequencing assumptions. Include key risks such as longevity, inflation, healthcare costs, and market volatility. Refresh the assumptions for Dana Copperwisp, whose recent inheritance of a partial interest in a family cabin near Bend, Oregon, college funding schedule for Lila and Owen, concentrated Moonbadger Robotics stock position, and target retirement around age 60 all affect the household's retirement income assumptions; her preliminary retirement spending target is $185,000 per year before taxes.", "priority": "high", "dueDate": "2026-03-20", "assigneeId": "3ca2316e-5349-5ea3-a000-4b0ccf1b4be9", "templateId": "5a5aaa12-3253-5f9f-8df5-9a2da4c1c633", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed to refresh retirement income assumptions, because Dana’s recent inheritance, college funding schedule, concentrated employer stock position, and target retirement age all affect the household’s retirement income assumptions; the date for this follow-up is 2026-03-20."},
{"title": "Complete concentrated position review intake", "text": "Client or household: Dana Copperwisp\nSecurity or holding description: Moonbadger Robotics stock\nApproximate market value: approximately $318,000\nEstimated cost basis: approximately $96,000\nAccount type and custodian: taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody\nPercent of investable assets: ____\nOriginal source of position: RSU vesting from her years at Moonbadger Robotics\nKnown restrictions, lockups, blackout windows, or trading policies: ____\nTax lots available? ____\nCharitable intent or gifting goals: ____\nLiquidity needs over the next 12 months: ____\nRisk tolerance concerns or downside threshold: concerned about reducing risk without creating an avoidable tax surprise; position is emotionally difficult to reduce\nNotes for advisor review: significant unrealized gain in the Moonbadger Robotics position within the approximately $842,000 taxable account.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2026-03-13", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": "5f7c3737-3474-57a7-9d62-4fd9eb30065b", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed to review concentrated employer stock exposure, because Dana’s taxable account includes a large Moonbadger Robotics stock position with significant unrealized gain, and she expressed concern about reducing risk without creating an avoidable tax surprise; the date for this follow-up is 2026-03-13."},
{"title": "Update beneficiary designations", "text": "Confirm current primary and contingent beneficiaries, prepare required custodian forms, and request client approval before submission. Check Dana Copperwisp's retirement account and life insurance beneficiaries after her father's death in 2025, because the 2016 estate documents still name her sister Maeve Copperwisp as successor trustee and the file does not show whether beneficiaries still match the household's current wishes; accounts include the rollover IRA and Roth IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody, Hugo Copperwisp's traditional IRA at Clockwork Clover Brokerage, and the Amber Teapot Life Insurance term policy.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2026-03-18", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": "22379042-123f-5108-bc07-63e5d3d2309c", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed to check beneficiary designations after family changes, because Dana’s estate documents still list her sister as successor trustee, and the file does not show whether retirement account and life insurance beneficiaries still match the household’s current wishes after her father’s death; the date for this follow-up is 2026-03-18."},
{"title": "Coordinate insurance policy review", "text": "Coordinate collection and review of insurance policy information, including coverage type, ownership, beneficiaries, premiums, riders, cash value if applicable, and any planning concerns. Use this template for life, disability, long-term care, or similar household risk-management policies. Review Dana Copperwisp's coverage file, which includes group life through Moonbadger Robotics at two times salary, an Amber Teapot Life Insurance term policy with a $750,000 death benefit and $1,140 annual premium, and umbrella liability through Coral Badger Insurance, but no current long-term care coverage entry or recent policy review notes.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2026-03-27", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": "cad3a151-544c-53dd-b813-a60042093dc2", "subTasks": [
{"title": "Collect policy documents and client questions", "text": "Request current declarations, policy statements, illustrations if available, premium notices, and the client’s main questions or concerns about coverage.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "22bf459b-abbb-576b-9589-52aff54f5760", "dueDate": null},
{"title": "Review planning fit and cash flow impact", "text": "Evaluate how premiums, coverage levels, ownership, and beneficiaries fit with the client’s broader financial plan and retirement income needs.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "1c9ad76e-0a4d-5171-a14b-0f748d960374", "dueDate": null},
{"title": "Check tax and estate planning considerations", "text": "Identify potential tax, estate, or gifting coordination issues and note whether outside insurance, legal, or tax professionals should be consulted.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "c461d4b9-57e0-57e0-8e67-25440f767e83", "dueDate": null},
{"title": "Prepare client-ready summary", "text": "Summarize key findings, missing information, recommended follow-ups, and any outside professional questions for advisor approval.", "priority": "medium", "assigneeId": "22bf459b-abbb-576b-9589-52aff54f5760", "dueDate": null}
], "evidence": "They agreed to review the insurance coverage file, because Dana’s planning file includes group life, term life, and umbrella coverage, but no current long-term care coverage entry or recent policy review notes were available during the call; the date for this follow-up is 2026-03-27."},
{"title": "Complete account security follow-up checks", "text": "Use this checklist after any suspected account access issue:\n- Confirm the client’s identity using approved verification procedures.\n- Ask whether any unauthorized transfers, profile changes, or new payees are visible.\n- Recommend password changes and multifactor authentication updates where available.\n- Review recent contact information changes, bank link changes, and distribution requests.\n- Notify the custodian through approved service channels if suspicious activity is reported.\n- Document the timeline, client statements, actions taken, and any unresolved risk items.\n- Escalate to compliance if fraud, identity theft, or unauthorized trading may have occurred.\nInvestigate the Velvet Acorn Custody login alert Dana Copperwisp received when she was not attempting to access the account; she saw no unauthorized transfers when she checked the account before the call.", "priority": "high", "dueDate": "2026-02-18", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": "7ef591cb-87f1-57c2-98f9-9584dbbf4f3f", "subTasks": [], "evidence": "They agreed to investigate the custodian login alert in light of that report; the date for this follow-up is 2026-02-18."}
]}
